If you succeed: advance. If you fail: skip to 9.11
This is literally the lockpicking minigame from TES 5: Skyrim. Even if you’ve never played Skyrim, you’ll likely figure it out by just trying things. Remember that if you fail, you can simply roll back and try again. But if you’re struggling, here is how it works:
The goal is to turn the lock’s cylinder a full 90 degrees clockwise. You can turn the cylinder by holding the left mouse button. However, you can only actually turn the cylinder the full 90 degrees if the lockpick is in the optimal position. You don’t know where this optimal position is, you have to figure that out. If the cylinder won’t turn at all, the lockpick is far from the optimal positon. The closer the lockpick gets to the optimal position, the further you can turn the cylinder.
When you try to turn the cylinder further than the lockpick allows, the lockpick will receive damage. Once the lockpick has been damaged too much, it breaks, and you have to use a new one. You lose the minigame after you’ve broken all four lockpicks. So: Every time you turn the cylinder, only long tap the button repeatedly, to not damage the lockpick more than necessary.
So, the strategy is: Put the lockpick into random positions and try to turn the cylinder. Once the cylinder turns a bit, make small adjustments to get closer and closer to the optimal position. Remember to only long tap when turning the cylinder. The lockpick’s optimal position is random every time you start the minigame, but it stays the same when you break a lockpick.

Пробуй разные углы и сразу отпускай кнопку, как только цилиндр упирается: давление ломает отмычку. Если цилиндр немного повернулся, корректируй угол небольшими движениями. Нужный угол выбирается заново при запуске мини-игры, но не меняется при поломке отмычки.

blocks.text:
If: You have at least 5 interview points
Then: Powell leaves the office and you successfully hack his PC!
Also Луна +1 if ветка Луна активна (delayed)
Otherwise: Powell won’t leave his office, so your mission fails. Though there are talks that maybe your team can gain access another way.
blocks.ru: Если ты набрал хотя бы 5 очков на собеседовании, Пауэлл выйдет из кабинета, а ты взломаешь его компьютер. Позже Луна +1, если её ветка активна. Иначе Пауэлл останется в кабинете и задание сорвётся. Возможно, команда найдёт другой способ получить доступ.

blocks.text:
Requirement: ветка Луна активна (otherwise, skip to the chapter ending)
If you don’t have all of Luna’s Outfits that were unlockable so far, you unlock
them all now. (This is probably to fix the saves of people who couldn’t get all of them in an earlier game version due to a bug.)
blocks.ru: Если ветка Луны закрыта, переходи к финалу главы. Иначе здесь откроются все доступные к этому моменту образы Луны, которые ты ещё не получил. Возможно, так автор игры исправил последствия старой ошибки.
